scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix api-node" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace api-node && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api-node && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build
